title: Docs: say which earlier records keep their recorded rules in the registered committed-input section
outcome: docs/features/execution-observability.md's "One rule for a registered committed-input check" names the exempt records exactly, so no reader takes an earlier committed-input check record as escaping the clean-root rule.
acceptance: The sentence 'Staged-tree inputs and earlier records keep the rules they were recorded under' is replaced by wording that names the exempt records as Engram does: staged-tree inputs, and evaluations, obligation resolutions, seals and registered_input_witness records made before the rule. It also says that an earlier build's registered committed-input check is still read from Git when a new passing evaluation or done uses it.
The wording is checked against Engram's acceptance-evaluation.md, "Registered Git-input evidence", and the change lands under the standing rule.
